data.name: Paper Boats

heroImage.alt: A paper boat floating along a winding canal through a cozy town, surrounded by ducks, autumn leaves, collectible stars and stickers

data.fullDescription: Paper Boats — a casual game about a boat folded from a page of a notebook. After a rainstorm the street turns into a river, and your boat floats from one end to the other. Nudge the water to steer around leaves and ducks. Collect stickers on the way.
